item.title: Microsoft under investigation by UK watchdog over misleading customers on subscriptions
item.description: Competition and Markets Authority said it has reached no conclusions about whether Microsoft broke the law.

media:content.media:text: Annual customers on the Microsoft 365 Personal and Family Plan paid £25 more than the Classic version - (Alamy/PA)

item.title: Iced matcha, salads and picnic sausage rolls help Greggs weather heatwave
item.description: The bakery chain revealed its sales increased over the first half of 2026 while its expansion across the UK continued.

media:content.media:text: Greggs said more people had been buying salads and iced drinks in the hot weather (Greggs/PA) - (Greggs)

item.title: Standard Chartered launches fresh £750m share buyback after record profits
item.description: Bill Winters, chief executive of Standard Chartered, said the new shareholder returns ‘reflect our confidence in the business’.

media:content.media:text: Standard Chartered has pledged to double investment in its fast-growing wealth management business as the bank raised its outlook after a forecast-beating third quarter (Alamy/PA) -
